data.summary: Landed via PR #41 (squash-merged, checks green). smoke.sh now asserts the tool surface by named list against the twelve registrations (missing/unexpected tools fail with names; verified by deleting release_claim locally). release.yml npm job gained setup-go + a smoke step BEFORE npm publish — a tag can no longer publish a package whose smoke test fails; WORKFLOW CHANGE flagged in the PR body for Brandon eyes-on review per law, two steps only, pinned SHAs match existing usage. Makefile stamps -X main.version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty) so make build binaries report a real version. v0.2.0 will be the first release through the gate.
